about: La Forge free-text answers from the live walks, graded as the second check grades them: the Atelier corrector's sentence round on the item's grammar unit, then the merge that holds the model's reading to the item's accepted answers. 'truth.correct' is whether the answer is right French for the prompt (missing capitals, final punctuation and, under the lenient accent policy, accents do not make it wrong); 'truth.errors' lists the real errors.

items.source: live walk 2026-10-30, finding 5 (verbatim); #380
items.prompt: We prefer Le Mistral, Lila.
items.example_answer: On préfère Le Mistral, Lila.
items.learner_text: Nous préférons Le Mistral, Lila.

truth.note: «nous préférons» is a valid variant of «on préfère»

items.source: live walk 2026-10-30, finding 5 (screenshot f-nous-prefer-accents-rejected)
items.prompt: We prefer Le Mistral, Lila.
items.example_answer: On préfère Le Mistral, Lila.
items.learner_text: Nous preferons le Mistral, Lila

truth.note: missing accent on préférons: name it, do not fail the answer
